fusions.name: Arcane Chaff
fusions.desc: Flicks a scrap of loose arcana that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Gathered Static
fusions.desc: Releases the arcana gathered on the tines, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Glean the Leylines
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Residue of Spells
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, 4 mana comes back to you. Once every 8 seconds.
